result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now exists as a second name for `updateLandscape`. Both go through the same code with the same options. The `cli` module tests pass, but I didn't run the command itself, so I haven't confirmed that it creates `_sokrates_landscape/config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`**: added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and its description. The description calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and says it is the same as `updateLandscape`. It is also listed in the no-argument usage overview, using the landscape options.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: dispatch accepts either name. With `-help`, the usage printed is for the name the user typed.
- **`README.md`**: it had no command descriptions, so I added a short "Commands" section covering `init`, `generateReports`, `updateConfig` and `analyzeLandscape`. It notes that `updateLandscape` is the older name and keeps working.

Nothing is committed.
